Rooms.Name: The Dungeon
Rooms.Description:
These dungeon rooms all seem the same. There are signs of recent battles
everywhere.

Exits.Description: There is a shimmering light.

Rooms.Name: The Dungeon Moongate
Rooms.Description: You feel safe within the blue glow of the moongate.

Rooms.Name: Minoc
Rooms.Description:
The moongate has led to the ocean side city of Minoc. To the north, there
is the sea, and to the south there is the town of Minoc.

Rooms.Name: The Armourer
Rooms.Description:
The Armourer buys and sells armour. His smithy is impressive with all
of his greatest works hanging on the walls.

Rooms.Name: Minoc's Fountain
Rooms.Description:
This is the entrance of Minoc. To the east you see the weaponsmith, and
to the west is the Armourer. To the south there seems to be a large road.

Rooms.Name: The Weaponsmith
Rooms.Description:
The best Weaponsmith in the realm is here. His shop is full of hanging
weapons.

Rooms.Name: The Boat seller
Rooms.Description: This is the shop where you can purchase vehicles to cross the sea.

Rooms.Name: Sacrifice Street
Rooms.Description:
This Street goes from east to west. To the west is a shop and to the
south is a home.

Rooms.Name: Sacrifice Street
Rooms.Description:
This street runs from east to west. To the west there is a shop, and to
the east there is a forge.

Rooms.Name: Sacrifice Street
Rooms.Description:
This street runs from west to east. There is a home to the south and
forge to the east.

Rooms.Name: Forge
Rooms.Description:
The heat of this place causes blisters to form. The rhythmic beat of
hammer against the forge causes you to believe that someone is working
here.

Rooms.Name: Residence
Rooms.Description:
This residence is very small. It befits the teaching of sacrifice
without any item that is extra.

Rooms.Name: Residence
Rooms.Description:
This residence is very small. It befits the teaching of sacrifice
without any item that is extra.

Rooms.Name: The Beach
Rooms.Description: The beach ends here. You can go east or west.

Rooms.Name: The Beach
Rooms.Description:
The beach extends from west to east, but the waves are too heavy here
to enter the ocean.

Rooms.Name: The Beach
Rooms.Description:
The beach here is perfect, glistening white sands, perfect sun. Too bad
there is a monster infestation....

Rooms.Name: The Beach
Rooms.Description: The beach seems so idyllic, too bad these monster keep showing up.

Rooms.Name: The Beach
Rooms.Description: The beach ends here.

Rooms.Name: The Whirlpool
Rooms.Description:
The whirlpool rages all around you, whipping the water to a fine
spray which stings your eyes. Bits of wood bob helplessly in the
currents, presumably some boat broken up by the torrent. The whirlpool
looks the same in every direction - how could anyone find their way
through this?

Exits.Description: Wind whips the spray up into your eyes - you can see nothing!
Wind whips the spray up into your eyes - you can see nothing!
A lagoon lies to the south.
Wind whips the spray up into your eyes - you can see nothing!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
They seem completely oblivious to the adverse conditions, they just
keep circling, looking for some place to land. They appear to be
making their way gradually east.

Wind whips the spray up into your eyes - you can see nothing!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Some weak-bellied adventurer being sick over the side of his boat
no doubt. The helmet appears to be being carried east by the
currents.

The whirlpool rages all around you, whipping the water to a fine

Exits.Description: The flashes of light appear to be coming from this direction!
Wind whips the spray up into your eyes - you can see nothing!
Wind whips the spray up into your eyes - you can see nothing!
Wind whips the spray up into your eyes - you can see nothing!

Rooms.Name: The Minoc Moongate
Rooms.Description:
All around the whirlpool rages, but there is a calm about this
place. The water is flat as a millpond, and faint light emanating
from the moongate tinges everything blue.

Exits.Description: Wind whips the spray up into your eyes - you can see nothing!
Wind whips the spray up into your eyes - you can see nothing!
Wind whips the spray up into your eyes - you can see nothing!
Wind whips the spray up into your eyes - you can see nothing!

Rooms.Name: A Campfire
Rooms.Description:
This campfire sits in the middle of the camp. Many of the paladins
stand by it looking at the desert beyond. Some just wander by. To the
south is a small tent, to the north are more tents.

Rooms.Name: Between the Tents
Rooms.Description: There is a grand tent to the south, entered into through the east.

Rooms.Name: In front of the Grand Tent
Rooms.Description: To the south, there is a huge tent. To the east lies a smaller tent.

Rooms.Name: A Small Tent
Rooms.Description:
The paladin's tent is very Spartan, as he has to live without much in
order to develop his Honor.

Rooms.Name: A Small Tent
Rooms.Description:
The paladin's tent is very Spartan, as he has to live without much in
order to develop his Honor.

Rooms.Name: The Treasure Tent
Rooms.Description:
There is a HUGE pile of treasure here. It is truly immense. It would
make you easily a millionaire. If you could even take a tenth of it, you
could buy your levels. But the treasure is surrounded by a shield. A
shield that only the truly Honorable could get through. And if you were
truly honorable you wouldn't take the treasure.

Rooms.Name: The Grand Tent
Rooms.Description:
This tent is absolutely huge. To the east is the map room. To the south
there is Dupre. To the east is the treasure room.

Rooms.Name: The Map Tent
Rooms.Description:
This room has many maps and scrolls all over the table. There may be
one in particular that interests you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The scroll reads as follows:

Dear Lord British,
   This is Dupre reporting about the paladin expedition.  We are in the
process of clearing the desert of those annoying sandtraps.  Unfortunately
one of my men had wandered into the dragon cave and was slain by that evil
creature.  We need another knight, and also, the dragon had a moonstone.
Thank you, my liege.
                      Your Servant,
                         Dupre

The map has a rough drawing of the camp and to the north a small segment
of the desert, and a drawing of a winged lizard near the very north.

Rooms.Name: Dupre's Tent
Rooms.Description: This is the commander tent. It is full of commander type things.

Rooms.Name: A Small Tent
Rooms.Description:
The paladin's tent is very Spartan, as he has to live without much in
order to develop his Honor.

Rooms.Name: Desert Entrance
Rooms.Description:
You feel the hot desert wind blow sand into your face as you look at
those dunes.

Rooms.Name: A Small Tent
Rooms.Description:
The paladin's tent is very Spartan, as he has to live without much in
order to develop his Honor.

Rooms.Name: The Desert
Rooms.Description:
The desert in the northeast part of Britannia is a perfect example of
its kind. Dry, ugly, and lots of sand.

Exits.Description: There is a shimmering light.

Rooms.Name: The Desert
Rooms.Description:
The Desert is an ugly place. Sand whips into your eyes, making you
unsure of where you are and what you see.

Rooms.Name: The Desert
Rooms.Description: You trudge on. This desert seems endless.

Exits.Description: There is a shimmering light.

Rooms.Name: The Desert Moongate
Rooms.Description:
Your thirst seems to slacken as you see the comforting glow of the
moongate.

Rooms.Name: The Desert Moongate
Rooms.Description:
Your thirst seems to slacken as you see the comforting glow of the
moongate.

Exits.Description: There is just blue.

Rooms.Name: The Desert
Rooms.Description:
There is a large cave to the north. Smoke pours out of it at regular
intervals.

Exits.Description: The smoke obscures all vision.

Rooms.Name: The Desert
Rooms.Description: The sands blows into your ear and eyes.

Exits.Description: There is a shimmering light.

Rooms.Name: The Desert Moongate
Rooms.Description:
Your thirst seems to slacken as you see the comforting glow of the
moongate.

Exits.Description: There is just blue.

Rooms.Name: The Dragon Cave
Rooms.Description: The cave is smoky. There is a glint of gold.

Rooms.Name: The Shrine of Spirituality
Rooms.Description:
In this room a huge ankh sits on a pedestal. The Shrine is the source
of all magical power. The Timelord himself lives here. There is a moongate
here also, and last of all there is a huge engraving taking up the west
wall.

Exits.Description: You peer into the blackness, and hear shrieks and sounds totally inhuman.
Peace infuses your body. The graveyard is a solemn and sobering place.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Pilgrim,
     You have reached the final step on your way to enlightenment.  In
this last step you will be shown ultimate evil to your north, and ultimate
good to your south.  This is the land of the undead.

Both those whose goodness links them to the land, and those whose evilness
was rejected dead are here.  To have true spirituality one must know both.
Once you have been strengthened and forge through the evil, there is one
final test before you prove yourself equal to the Avatar himself.  You
must endure the test of time.

Through your entire journey you have not understood the real symbol of the
ankh.  Its true beauty only realizes itself to you now.  This knowledge
transcends all that come before.

Rooms.Name: The Place of Ultimate Evil
Rooms.Description: The ground itself seems malevolent. It sinks and engulfs you.

Rooms.Name: The Place of Ultimate Evil
Rooms.Description: The air sickens you. You choke on whatever flows through the air.

Rooms.Name: The Place of Ultimate Evil
Rooms.Description:
It is dark, there is no evidence of light except what you have with
you. And this is swallowed by the darkness within 2 feet.

Rooms.Name: The Place of Ultimate Evil
Rooms.Description:
Sounds are very weird in this place. Some sounds, like shrieks and
blood-curdling shouts are amplified, and you hear them frequently. Others
like your own voice, will not travel to beyond a inch from your face.

Rooms.Name: The Place of Ultimate Evil
Rooms.Description:
When you enter this place all of your senses are immediately blasted.
You breath in that total evilness and feel dirty. You want to leave right
now.

Rooms.Name: The Place of Ultimate Evil
Rooms.Description: You feel things all over your body. Sucking it and hurting it.

Rooms.Name: The Graveyard
Rooms.Description:
The graveyard background noises seem to soothe you. There is light and
peace. Your own voice carries so well and softly that you seem to be
telepathically communicating.

Rooms.Name: The Graveyard
Rooms.Description:
When you walk into here you are immediately soothed. Nothing could be
wrong with the world. All your senses are pleased.

Exits.Description: There is a shimmering light.

Rooms.Name: The Graveyard
Rooms.Description: You feel a light breath of air under your clothing. It massages you.

Rooms.Name: The Graveyard
Rooms.Description:
The ground itself here seems to welcome your footsteps. It is springy
and causes you little fatigue.

Rooms.Name: The Graveyard
Rooms.Description: The scent of the air refreshes you. It is sweet and lovely.

Rooms.Name: The Graveyard
Rooms.Description: The light here is bright and lovely.

Rooms.Name: Lord British's Castle Entrance
Rooms.Description:
This building is awe-inspiring, just smaller then Yaz's own. Anyway,
Lord British's personal Jester is here to entertain you.

Exits.Description: You see a fountain.

Rooms.Name: Castle Fountain
Rooms.Description: A lovely fountain sits here. To the north you see a guard.

Rooms.Name: A staircase
Rooms.Description:
There is a magical staircase going up. Beware, for those who go up
shall not return down. The other exits except for the west are closed for
construction.

Exits.Description: You see the altars of enlightenment.

Rooms.Name: Hallways
Rooms.Description:
This is the entrance for Lord British. Through the great doors to the
north you can enter. Another hallways passes across this one.

Rooms.Name: Hallway
Rooms.Description:
This is a hallway that would regularly extend from west to east, but it
is closed for reconstruction. There is a room to your north that can be
entered.

Rooms.Name: The Throne Room
Rooms.Description:
In the Throne Room there are the two most important figures in the
world.  The Avatar and Lord British himself.

Rooms.Name: Batlin's Room
Rooms.Description: Batlin, the molester of animals, and the general jerk, lives here.

Rooms.Name: The Altar of Honesty
Rooms.Description:
You may gain true enlightenment here. There is a large plaque on the
wall.  The path continues only if you use the mantra, to gain
enlightenment.

Exits.Description: The Path Of Enlightenment leads on.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Honesty is the scrupulous respect for truth, the willingness never to
deceive oneself or another.

Rooms.Name: The Altar of Compassion
Rooms.Description:
You may gain true enlightenment here. There is a large plaque on the
wall.  The path continues only if you use the mantra, to gain
enlightenment.

Exits.Description: The Path Of Enlightenment leads on.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Compassion is non-judgmental empathy for one's fellow creatures.  It is
pure love.

Rooms.Name: The Altar of Valor
Rooms.Description:
You may gain true enlightenment here. There is a large plaque on the
wall.  The path continues only if you use the mantra, to gain
enlightenment.

Exits.Description: The Path Of Enlightenment leads on.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Valor is the courage to take actions in support of one's convictions.

Rooms.Name: The Altar of Justice
Rooms.Description:
You may gain true enlightenment here. There is a large plaque on the
wall.  The path continues only if you use the mantra, to gain
enlightenment.

Exits.Description: The Path Of Enlightenment leads on.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Justice is devotion to truth, tempered by love.

Rooms.Name: The Altar of Sacrifice
Rooms.Description:
You may gain true enlightenment here. There is a large plaque on the
wall.  The path continues only if you use the mantra, to gain
enlightenment.

Exits.Description: The Path Of Enlightenment leads on.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Sacrifice is the courage to give of oneself in the name of love.

Rooms.Name: The Altar of Honour
Rooms.Description:
You may gain true enlightenment here. There is a large plaque on the
wall.  The path continues only if you use the mantra, to gain
enlightenment.

Exits.Description: The Path Of Enlightenment leads on.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Honour is the courage to stand for truth, against any odds.

Rooms.Name: The Altar of Spirituality
Rooms.Description:
You may gain true enlightenment here. There is a large plaque on the
wall.  The path continues only if you use the mantra, to gain
enlightenment.

Exits.Description: The Path Of Enlightenment leads on.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Spirituality is the concern with one's inner being and how one deals with
truth, love, and courage.

Rooms.Name: The Altar of Humility
Rooms.Description:
You may gain true enlightenment here. There is a large plaque on the
wall.  The path continues only if you use the mantra, to gain
enlightenment.

Exits.Description: The Path Of Enlightenment ends there.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Humility is perceiving one's place in the world, not according to one's
own accomplishments, but according to the intrinsic value of all
individuals.

Rooms.Name: The Enlightenment
Rooms.Description:
A voice booms out, "You are now eight part enlightened. To truly become
an Avatar, though, you must experience what he has experienced. Go through
the time warp and fight his enemies. Beware, only High Mortals should
attempt this challenge."

Exits.Description: The Time Warp changes space, and fluxes its surroundings.

Rooms.Name: In the Warp
Rooms.Description:
This is a forest. You were sent very far back in time. Before there was
a Britannia. Almost before there was a Lord British. This is the time of
Mondain.  The first enemy that the Avatar met.

Exits.Description: The Time Warp leads you to another place.

Rooms.Name: In the Warp
Rooms.Description:
You are in a featureless room. You see the apprentice and lover of
Mondain here. She does not seem happy to see you.

Exits.Description: The Time Warp zips to the future.

Rooms.Name: In the Warp
Rooms.Description:
You see the last of the Triad of Evil. With its destruction came the
breaking of the world.

Exits.Description: The Time Warp continues on.

Rooms.Name: The Enlightenment
Rooms.Description:
A voice booms out, "You have now truly became Enlightened. You have
fought and defeated the Avatar's enemy of the past. Now the time warp
leads to the future. Only the truly courageous can survive the enemies
there."

Exits.Description: The Time Warp changes space, and fluxes its surroundings.

Rooms.Name: In the Warp
Rooms.Description:
You seem to be in a castle. But there are torture devices here, and an
angry King.

Exits.Description: The Time Warp sputters and crackles.

Rooms.Name: In the Warp
Rooms.Description:
You seem to be in a blue room. It appears to be only 2 dimensional as
it sparkles. There is also a big red face here.

Rooms.Name: The Lagoon
Rooms.Description:
The whirlpool-like ocean is to the north, and the beach is back to the
east.

Exits.Description: The Ocean Roars.
The beach sparkles.

Mobs.Name: jester chuckles
Mobs.LongDescription: Chuckles the Jester is juggling and entertaining here.
Mobs.Description:
Chuckles the Jester is here mumbling, 'Spam Spam.' This annoying
characteristic is Lord British's major entertainment. He is
laughing and telling corny jokes. He seems to hold his dinner
in his hands, and when he dance the bells on his hat jingle merrily.
Mobs.ActionScript: %10 chuckle;%10 cackle;%10 laugh;%10 emote yells, 'Spam Spam'

Mobs.Name: mimic
Mobs.LongDescription: A treasure chest is here, overflowing with gold.
Mobs.Description:
The treasure chest reforms, and spits out a
glob of poison. Beware adventurer of the Mimic.

Mobs.Name: gazer eyeball
Mobs.LongDescription: A floating eyeball glares at you.
Mobs.Description:
This creature is comprised of one main eyeball and several
auxiliary eyeballs coming of the main. The eyeballs draw
you in, making you forget who you are...

Mobs.Name: tinker
Mobs.LongDescription: A tinker is fiddling with one device or another.
Mobs.Description:
The tinker has huge rippling muscles and a scarred skin.
You realize that his great Sacrifice to his craft has led
to his incredible strength and weaponskill. This is not
one you wish to fight.

Mobs.Name: julia
Mobs.LongDescription: Julia the Tinker is here forging a sword.
Mobs.Description:
Julia the Tinker provided some of the muscle power to the Avatar,
during his Great Quest for enlightenment. She was a Warrior of
Destiny and you see that not much has changed since those days.
She represents Sacrifice in everything she does. She is the Keeper
of Oral History, as well as a prominent weaponsmith.

Mobs.Name: lady
Mobs.LongDescription: The Lady of Empath Abbey stands here.
Mobs.Description:
When you see her your heart almost stops, as you feel the intense
waves of pure Love come from here body. Her love for you almost
knocks you down. You cannot hurt this one.

Mobs.Name: sandtrap tentacle
Mobs.LongDescription: A tentacle reaches out of the sand, and latches onto your leg.
Mobs.Description:
The sandtrap burrows around under the stand, and comes
onto travellers hidden. No one is really sure what the
Sandtrap looks like, but it is a dangerous foe.

Mobs.Name: dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: A dragon is here lying on his heap of treasure.
Mobs.Description:
The dragon looks like every other dragon you've seen, wings,
tail, fire. Only this one doesn't have a dorky color attached
to it. And doesn't talk about annoying C++ terms.

Mobs.Name: paladin
Mobs.LongDescription: A paladin practices his sword strokes here.
Mobs.Description:
This paladin works hard to keep his Honor and the Honor of
his people. Honor does not lead his life, Honor is his life.
His shiny armour and equally shiny sword serves to remind you
that he is among Brittannia's most powerful battalion.

Mobs.Name: dupre paladin
Mobs.LongDescription: Sitting here, Dupre the Paladin consults his maps.
Mobs.Description:
Dupre the Paladin was constant companion of the Avatar and a
Warrior of Destiny. He is a symbol of Honor. He is currently
trying devise a plan of attack to get the dragon.

Mobs.Name: reaper
Mobs.LongDescription: The reaper strikes out with his tentacles.
Mobs.Description:
The reaper is immobilized and attached to the ground.
Even with this disadvantage his tentacles and magical
powers more then make up for disadvantage.

Mobs.Name: gargoyle king draxthanum
Mobs.LongDescription: The King of Gargoyles is here.
Mobs.Description:
Draxthanum the Winged Gargoyle is here to observe the odd habits
of humans and there combat tactics. He is red with wings, and is
strong and his aura is overpowering.

Mobs.Name: ghost spirit
Mobs.LongDescription: The spirit of peaceful man floats around here.
Mobs.Description:
This ghost seems peaceful, even though he is chained
to the earth through some responsibility.

Mobs.Name: ghost spirit
Mobs.LongDescription: This ghost was an evil man in a past life.
Mobs.Description:
In through its transparent face, you can see a
grimace of evilness and swoops over to you.

Mobs.Name: skeleton
Mobs.LongDescription: The skeleton walks around in tattered clothing.
Mobs.Description:
The skeleton has rotting bits of flesh attached to its bones.
It carries a rusty shield and sword. In fact the only thing
completely clean on it is its white teeth, perhaps from its
nightly meals of flesh and bone.

Mobs.Name: demon demon
Mobs.LongDescription: A demon unfurls his wings and swoops into you.
Mobs.Description:
The most dangerous undead, and among the most dangerous of all
monsters, this beast can use all magics, is strong and hardy.
Right now he seems to be busy...killing you.

Mobs.Name: mourner
Mobs.LongDescription: A mourner bows his head over the grave.
Mobs.Description:
A mourner is in tears. She is crying over the grave of a loved
one. She is expressing poignant Spirituality. This gives her
strength to persevere.

Mobs.Name: shamino ranger
Mobs.LongDescription: Shamino the Ranger sits here, meditating.
Mobs.Description:
The last Warrior of Destiny, Shamino sits here in a yoga
position. The Enlightened smile on his face confirms that he
indeed is one with the spirit of Spirituality.

Mobs.Name: timelord
Mobs.LongDescription: The Timelord is here in an aura of power.
Mobs.Description:
The Hourglass that he holds in his hand actually controls the
fickle powers of time. This being is so awe-inspiring that you
fell an urge to prostrate yourself to him. But as all godly
powers must be, he is truly and totally neutral.

Mobs.Name: guardian
Mobs.LongDescription: The Guardian as far as you can tell is just a big red face.
Mobs.Description:
First you hear a booming voice. 'You WILL join the Fellowship.'
He is the latest, and some people say greatest of the Avatar's
enemies. And now you have the joy of meeting him.
Mobs.ActionScript: %10 say You WILL join the Fellowship!

Mobs.Name: blackthorn
Mobs.LongDescription: Blackthorn wonders how he lost the throne.
Mobs.Description:
Blackthorn was more misguided rather then evil. Though he was
still a foe of Avatar that eventually was destroyed, during this
era he still is corrupt and VERY, VERY dangerous.

Mobs.Name: exodus
Mobs.LongDescription: Exodus is here, reveling in his island fortress.
Mobs.Description:
Exodus, the horrible progeny of Minax and Mondain is here. More
powerful then his parents, he is also more dangerous. He was the
last of the Triad that the Avatar destroyed.

Mobs.Name: minax
Mobs.LongDescription: Minax is here conjuring up the evil spirits.
Mobs.Description:
More powerful then her master and lover, Minax is as beautiful as
she is dangerous. Bold enough to take on the forces of evil without
the gem, she eventually proved to be their mistress. Without the
Avatar the world would still be under her complete power.

Mobs.Name: mondain
Mobs.LongDescription: Mondain grips his evil gem and conjures magic to destroy you.
Mobs.Description:
Mondain. the first of the Triad of Evil, was the first foe that
the man, later to be known as the Avatar, was to face. Mondain
had killed his father to gain the power of the dark gem that he
wielded.

Mobs.Name: sentri
Mobs.LongDescription: Sentri stoically stands here, protecting his Lord and castle from harm.
Mobs.Description:
Sentri is a powerful man, whose only job is to protect the life
of Lord British. In seeing this done he is completely armoured
and wields a heavy blade.

Mobs.Name: batlin
Mobs.LongDescription: Batlin says, 'Join the Fellowship.'
Mobs.Description:
Batlin is an evil man that goes around and corrupts the young. 
He is though protected by the power of his god.

Mobs.Name: avatar
Mobs.LongDescription: The Avatar is here chatting to Lord British.
Mobs.Description:
The Avatar is the symbol of courage and truth and love, and all
that descends from it. He has mastered Compassion, Humility,
Justice, Spirituality, Honesty, Sacrifice, Valor, and Honor. He
truly is an inspiration to those who know him.

Mobs.Name: lord british
Mobs.LongDescription: Lord British is healing the Avatar's wounds.
Mobs.Description:
Lord British sits in his throne. When you see him, you know the
meaning of true leadership. His charisma is almost tangible. On
him you see the three crown jewels. These hold power both
figuratively and truly.

Mobs.Name: shark
Mobs.LongDescription: The shark smells blood.
Mobs.Description: This fish can sense blood in the water and comes to kill you.

Mobs.Name: seahorse seahorse
Mobs.LongDescription: The peaceful seahorse swims here.
Mobs.Description:
The seahorse is an amazingly beautiful creature. Its swimming
and diving please you.

Mobs.Name: squid
Mobs.LongDescription: The squid's tentacles reach for you.
Mobs.Description:
The squid easily is double the boat in size. Its tentacles
are huge and you fear as it grabs for you.

Objects.Name: mantra humility lum key
Objects.Description: Lum, the Mantra of Humility is here.

Objects.Name: mantra spirituality ohm key
Objects.Description: Ohm, the Mantra of Spirituality is here.

Objects.Name: mantra sacrifice cah key
Objects.Description: Cah, the Mantra of Sacrifice is here.

Objects.Name: mantra honour summ key honor
Objects.Description: Summ, the Mantra of Honour is here.

Objects.Name: moonstone key
Objects.Description: A totally featureless moonstone is here.

Objects.Name: moonstone key
Objects.Description: A totally featureless moonstone is here.

Objects.Name: moonstone key
Objects.Description: A totally featureless moonstone is here.

Objects.Name: hourglass key
Objects.Description: You feel an aura of power emmanating from the hourglass.

Objects.Name: chicken
Objects.Description: A chicken is lying on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you look closer you see this isn't a real chicken, 
it's one of those gag rubber chickens.

Objects.Name: hammer tinker
Objects.Description: A tinker's hammer lies here.

Objects.Name: sword
Objects.Description: Julia's hot, glowing sword lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Julia was working on this sword before you attacked her. Though
it has been removed from the forge for a long time, it seems to
continue to glow as if Julia's vengeful spirit has taken its
place.

Objects.Name: amulet love
Objects.Description: The most beautiful amulet lies in a pile here.

Objects.Name: avenger
Objects.Description: A shiny sword lies here.

Objects.Name: armour shiny
Objects.Description: A paladin's suit of armour lies here.

Objects.Name: rapier dupre
Objects.Description: Dupre's rapier is here.

Objects.Name: boomerang
Objects.Description: A gargoyle's boomerang is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Though this seems like your basic boomerang, it is much more. 
It hums with an unearthly tone, waiting for its power to be
unleashed.

Objects.Name: sword rusty
Objects.Description: A corroded, rusty sword is here.

Objects.Name: shield rusty
Objects.Description: A spiked rusty shield lies here.

Objects.Name: cloak magic
Objects.Description: A magic cloak is here.

Objects.Name: aura power
Objects.Description: A bright light of power shoots into the air.

Objects.Name: face big red
Objects.Description: The empty shell of the Guardian head lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
When you slew the evil Guardian, all that was left was his
corporal form that he inhabited. That of the big red head.

Objects.Name: mace spiked
Objects.Description: Waves of corruption come off this evilly enchanted spiked mace.

Objects.Name: armour black death
Objects.Description: This completely black armor reeks of death.

Objects.Name: charm evil
Objects.Description: You see a very oddly shaped charm...it might be worth it to look at its shape.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The charm looks to be a mummified part of a body. It 
is about 3 inches long, and...NO! It could not be...

Objects.Name: gem death
Objects.Description: The evil gem pulsates here.

Objects.Name: helmet sentri
Objects.Description: Sentri's helmet is here.

Objects.Name: sleeves sentri
Objects.Description: Sentri's sleeves lies here.

Objects.Name: girth sentri
Objects.Description: Sentri's girth is here.

Objects.Name: sword sentri two-handed
Objects.Description: Sentri's two-handed sword is here.

Objects.Name: gloves sentri
Objects.Description: Sentri's gloves are here.

Objects.Name: boots sentri
Objects.Description: Sentri's boots are here.

Objects.Name: leggings sentri
Objects.Description: Sentri left his leggings here.

Objects.Name: armour sentri
Objects.Description: Sentri left his armour here.

Objects.Name: medallion fellowship
Objects.Description: A triangular shaped medallion is here.

Objects.Name: sword glass
Objects.Description: The most amazingly well crafted sword lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Invisible to the naked eye, this sword is the best crafted, as
you look at it, its amazing shape and size brings tears to your
eyes. You know that this is the best weapon that you will ever
see.

Objects.Name: crown british
Objects.Description: A jewel encrusted crown is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Legend has it that this most perfect of crowns has within one of
its jewels, a perfect ray of sunlight. He who wears it must
truly be enlightened.

Objects.Name: sceptre british
Objects.Description: A pure gold sceptre is topped with a perfect crystal orb of power.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The second of the crown jewels, this sceptre is amazingly light,
and amazingly powerful. It is pure gold, but topped with an orb
of power.

The orb of power is transparent to the point of sightlessness. 
It holds within a vast store of power.

Objects.Name: silver amulet british
Objects.Description: A silver amulet lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: British's amulet is in the shape of the great earth serpent.

Objects.Name: fountain
Objects.Description: A fountain shaped in an Ankh pours water.
